PipeCalculatorProject.title: PipeCalculatorProject
PipeCalculatorProject.description: Represents a solar engineering pipe requirement calculation project with catalog sizes, line-item component breakdowns, and branding assets.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this project

userEmail.description: Email address of the project owner

projectName.description: Name of the solar project or site block

standardPipeLength.description: Standard commercially available pipe length value (e.g. 20 or 6)

pipeLengthUnit.description: Unit for pipe length (ft or m)

showBranding.description: Flag to toggle company branding header and watermark

noteText.description: Important notice or variation contingency text

logoUrl.description: Firebase Storage or public URL of the firm's logo

clientLogoUrl.description: Firebase Storage or public URL of the client's logo

pipeSizes.description: List of active pipe cross-section size designations

components.description: List of structural categories (Purlin, Rafter, Leg, Supports, etc.)

componentItems.description: Component workspace items containing individual cut lengths and member quantities

rows.description: Table rows with quantities and individual member cut lengths

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of document last update

/pipe_calculator_projects/{projectId}.description: Stores user solar pipe calculation projects and cut-lists
